source_text: Lifetime UTI prevalence in men shows little variance between high-circumcision contexts like the United States (13-14%) and low-circumcision nations like Sweden (13-14%), implying that infantile benefits exert negligible influence on cumulative risk, dominated instead by adult-onset drivers including prostate conditions. [84] [85]
